ctaBand.heading: Your trade can take you anywhere.
ctaBand.body: Send your CV and trade today. We call you when a matching requirement opens. Applying is always free.
hero.title: Get your job *abroad*.
hero.subheading: We train and place workers in all trades — welders, fitters, electricians, drivers, helpers and more — with employers in the Gulf, Europe and Asia. Applying is free.
route.title: From Visakhapatnam to your job abroad
route.noFee: You never pay a placement fee.
where.title: Workers in every trade, placed across the globe
where.intro: We place workers in all kinds of trades and job categories with employers worldwide, and prepare them for the job here in Visakhapatnam.
where.tradesMore: More trades we train and recruit
services.title: Three ways we put skills to work
services.intro: Find work abroad, learn a trade properly, or hire the people your project needs.
services.overseas.title: Overseas employment
services.overseas.summary: Jobs with employers in the Gulf, Europe and Asia, with help from the first call to the flight.
services.training.title: Training
services.training.summary: Hands-on welding 3G to 6G, electrical, fitting and piping at our workshop in Autonagar.
services.training.audience: For freshers & anyone learning a new skill
services.manpower.title: Manpower supply
services.manpower.summary: Skilled and semi-skilled tradespeople for projects, shutdowns and long-term contracts.
manpower.title: Need manpower?
manpower.intro: Travel agencies and HR teams send us their requirements. We supply trade-tested workers for India and overseas.
manpower.agency.title: Travel agencies
manpower.agency.body: You got a requirement from abroad? Send it to us and we supply trade-tested manpower.
manpower.agency.message: Hello {name}, I am from a travel agency. We need manpower for a requirement from abroad.
manpower.company.title: HR and direct companies
manpower.company.body: Tell us the trades and how many people you need. We source, test and mobilise them.
manpower.company.message: Hello {name}, I am from a company HR team. We need workers for a project.
manpower.note: For business and bulk requirements only. Candidates, please call our office on {phone}.
how.title: From your CV to your flight
how.intro: A clear path with one team beside you. You never pay to apply for a job.
how.step1.title: Send your CV and trade
how.step1.body: Online, on WhatsApp or at our Autonagar office. Tell us your trade and experience.
how.step2.title: We call you
how.step2.body: Our team talks you through the openings that match your trade and experience.
how.step3.title: Trade test or training
how.step3.body: Show your skill in a trade test, or train with us first to reach the level employers ask for.
how.step4.title: Visa, ticket, documents
how.step4.body: We guide you through medicals, visa, pre-departure orientation and travel papers.
how.step5.title: Fly to work
how.step5.body: You travel to your new job with your contract and contacts in hand.
training.title: Learn the trade in a real workshop
training.intro: Practical training at the Venkat Sai Welding Works and Testing Center in Autonagar, Gajuwaka. Results are recorded as Venkat Sai assessments.
training.welding34.title: Welding 3G / 4G
training.welding34.body: Plate and positional welding for structural work.
training.welding56.title: Welding 5G / 6G
training.welding56.body: Pipe welding in the positions overseas tests ask for.
training.pipeFitting.title: Pipe fitting
training.pipeFitting.body: Pipe fit-up, alignment and reading isometrics.
training.electrical.title: Electrical
training.electrical.body: Industrial wiring, panels and safe isolation.
training.rigging.title: Rigging
training.scaffolding.title: Scaffolding
training.scaffolding.body: Erecting and inspecting tube and system scaffolds.
training.ndt.title: NDT awareness
training.ndt.body: How welds are inspected and tested.
training.hse.title: HSE and safety
training.hse.body: Site safety, PPE and permits to work.
employers.title: Need welders, fitters or a full crew?
employers.intro: Tell us the trades, numbers, location and start date. We shortlist trade-tested candidates and handle the paperwork with you.
employers.point2: Single trades or full project crews

audiences.title: Partners and institutions
audiences.intro: Recruitment agencies, colleges and training institutes work with Venkat Sai through their own portals.
audiences.partners.title: Grow with a transparent recruitment network
audiences.partners.intro: Verified recruitment partners work on Venkat Sai requirements through their own portal, with clear commercial terms, candidate submissions and status tracking.
audiences.partners.point1: Access to requirements assigned to your agency
audiences.partners.point2: Submit candidates and follow their progress
audiences.partners.point3: Verification and compliance built into onboarding
audiences.institutions.title: Connect your students and trainees to industry
audiences.institutions.intro: Colleges, ITIs and training institutes can publish courses, run campus drives and internships, and connect learners to employers through the Institution & Training Portal.
audiences.institutions.point1: Publish courses and batches on the training catalogue
audiences.institutions.point2: Organise campus drives and internship programmes
audiences.institutions.point3: Record outcomes and issue verifiable certificates

faq.intro: Straight answers about applying, training and travel.

whatsapp.intro: New job requirements on your phone as soon as we post them.
candidates.meta.title: For candidates
candidates.meta.description: Build one career profile to discover and apply for jobs, internships and training in India and overseas. Venkat Sai never charges candidates.
candidates.title: Build your career profile. Open every door.
candidates.intro: One profile for jobs, internships, training and skill assessments — in India and abroad. Applying through Venkat Sai Global is always free.
candidates.benefits.title: What your profile does for you
candidates.benefits.discover.title: Discover verified opportunities
candidates.benefits.discover.description: Search jobs and internships from verified employers and Venkat Sai-managed requirements, with salary and location shown wherever the employer shares them.
candidates.benefits.apply.title: Apply in a few steps
candidates.benefits.apply.description: Your profile, documents and experience travel with every application, so you do not fill in the same details again.
candidates.benefits.track.title: Track every application
candidates.benefits.track.description: See where each application stands, from submission to interview and offer, in one place.
candidates.benefits.learn.title: Learn and qualify
candidates.benefits.learn.description: Join training programmes and Venkat Sai skill assessments to show employers what you can do.
candidates.benefits.language.title: Your language
candidates.benefits.language.description: The People Portal works in English, Hindi and Telugu.
candidates.benefits.privacy.title: You control your data
candidates.benefits.privacy.description: Choose who can see your profile and contact details, and request a copy or deletion of your data whenever you want.
candidates.eligible.title: Opportunities for every stage of a career
candidates.eligible.intro: Whether you are starting out or have years of experience in a trade, there is a place for you.
candidates.eligible.item1: Skilled tradespeople such as welders, fitters and electricians
candidates.eligible.item4: Freshers looking for internships and apprenticeships
candidates.eligible.item6: Anyone looking to train for a new skill
candidates.steps.title: Four steps to your next opportunity
candidates.steps.step1.title: Create your profile
candidates.steps.step1.description: Sign up with your phone number or email and add your skills, experience and documents.
candidates.steps.step2.title: Discover and apply
candidates.steps.step2.description: Search, save and apply for jobs, internships and training that match you.
candidates.steps.step3.title: Assessment and interview
candidates.steps.step3.description: Some roles include a trade test or skill assessment — always free for candidates.
candidates.steps.step4.title: Offer and onboarding
candidates.steps.step4.description: Receive your offer and, for overseas roles, documentation support and PDOT (Pre-Departure Orientation Training).
candidates.cta.heading: Your next opportunity starts with a profile
candidates.cta.body: It takes a few minutes and costs nothing — today or ever.
candidates.age: You must be 18 or older to create a full profile. Applicants under 18 need verifiable consent from a parent or guardian, and overseas roles are open only to adults.
candidates.safety.title: We never charge candidates
candidates.safety.body: Nobody should ask you for money to apply, be interviewed, be trade-tested or be placed through Venkat Sai. If anyone does, do not pay — report it to us. For overseas jobs, check that the recruiting agent is registered on the Government of India's eMigrate portal.
